_note: 2D map (item h). scripts/map2d.py samples the LOLA polar DEM (same grids and reading as config/horizon.json) on a square grid around each site with a terrain horizon, local north up, distances measured along the surface from the site (azimuthal equidistant). The page shades heights and draws the site, the terrain skyline points (item j) and the Sun and Earth directions at the chosen time. Relief shading uses a fixed light direction (cartographic convention), not the real Sun.

layers._note: P4k: layer buttons on the 2D map, first = default. heights = relief shading above; slope = degrees from the same LOLA heights (computed in the page, same gradient as the shading); sunlight = NASA GSFC PGDA average Sun visibility read on the same cells by scripts/map_sunlight.py (data/map-sunlight/), not computed by this tool. Colour stops are CSS tokens (src/styles.css); values outside the range are drawn at the end colour.
